data.summary: The factory-supplied `npm test` (cwd ui/) exited 0 with 48 of 48 tests passing, and `npm run build` exited 0 and produced 4 pages. I did not execute either command myself. Static inspection of the diff shows every acceptance criterion is implemented: the pre-paint inline script, the three-state cycle with localStorage persistence, the live system listener, the ThemeToggle beside PrivacyToggle in both headers, the bg-slate-900 Home/About box, and the theme-aware header and body. The remaining gaps are non-blocking: the browser checks were not run, and the project's `var` convention is not followed in the new JS.

executedCommands.command: npm test (cwd ui/; supplied by factory, not run by QA)
npm run build (cwd ui/; supplied by factory, not run by QA)

e2eChecks.name: AC1: no stored preference, OS light/dark sets html.dark
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Layout.astro inline script (no 'theme' key -> theme='system' -> matchMedia prefers-color-scheme)
e2eChecks.expected: No 'dark' class on OS light; 'dark' class on OS dark
e2eChecks.actual: Script computes isDark from matchMedia and toggles 'dark' on documentElement

e2eChecks.name: AC2: stored 'dark' wins before first paint
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Layout.astro: inline <script is:inline> in <head>
e2eChecks.expected: localStorage theme='dark' -> class 'dark' regardless of OS, applied in head
e2eChecks.actual: Script runs synchronously in <head> and forces isDark=true for stored 'dark'

e2eChecks.name: AC3: stored 'light' overrides OS dark
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Layout.astro and theme.js resolveIsDark
e2eChecks.expected: No 'dark' class when stored 'light' and OS dark
e2eChecks.actual: resolveIsDark('light', true) === false; inline script only adds class when isDark

e2eChecks.name: AC4: 'system' follows live OS change
e2eChecks.request: Static read of ThemeToggle.jsx change listener
e2eChecks.expected: 'dark' class updates on matchMedia change without reload while theme is 'system'
e2eChecks.actual: addEventListener('change') attached only when theme==='system' and calls applyTheme('system', ...)

e2eChecks.name: AC5: click cycles light->dark->system->light, saves 'theme', updates html immediately
e2eChecks.request: Static read of ThemeToggle.cycleTheme + theme.js nextTheme/storeTheme/applyTheme
e2eChecks.expected: Cycle order, localStorage key 'theme', immediate class update
e2eChecks.actual: nextTheme cycles THEMES in that order; storeTheme writes THEME_STORAGE_KEY='theme'; applyTheme called synchronously in the click handler

e2eChecks.name: AC6: theme button beside eye button in desktop and mobile headers with accessible label
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Header.astro markup and ThemeToggle aria-label
e2eChecks.expected: ThemeToggle immediately after PrivacyToggle in both containers; aria-label names current mode
e2eChecks.actual: Desktop and mobile both render PrivacyToggle then ThemeToggle; aria-label is 'Theme: Light|Dark|System default'. Visual placement at real widths not run.

e2eChecks.name: AC7: Home/About inside bg-slate-900 box with light link text in both themes
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Header.astro desktop and mobile <ul>
e2eChecks.expected: bg-slate-900 container, light link text, independent of theme
e2eChecks.actual: Both <ul> carry bg-slate-900 text-white; linkInactive uses text-gray-200, linkActive uses text-white

e2eChecks.name: AC8: header, body and text colours switch with theme
e2eChecks.request: Static read of Header nav/span/body classes and global.css .dark overrides
e2eChecks.expected: Header bg, body bg and text switch; no light header on dark page
e2eChecks.actual: nav dark:bg-slate-900/80; body dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100; global.css overrides cover bg-white/gray/slate and text-gray/slate. Coverage of every component surface was not verified in a browser.

e2eChecks.name: AC9: theme.js unit tests pass and build completes
e2eChecks.request: npm test and npm run build (factory-supplied output)
e2eChecks.expected: Exit 0 for both; theme.test.js cases pass
e2eChecks.actual: npm test exit 0, 48/48 pass including normalizeTheme, nextTheme, resolveIsDark, storage and applyTheme suites; npm run build exit 0

evidence: The diff only adds tests (ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js is a new file); no existing test is deleted, skipped, disabled or loosened.
No .skip, .only, @Disabled or xit/xdescribe added in the diff.
Existing test files were not modified in the diff.

bugReports.title: New JS uses const for locals, violating AGENTS.md var convention
stepsToReproduce: Observe local variables declared with const (for example, 'const index', 'const prefersDark', 'const mediaQuery', 'const label', 'const Icon')
bugReports.expected: AGENTS.md 'Additional Notes': use var for local variable declarations within methods wherever possible.
bugReports.actual: Every local in the new files is const. ForecastUtils.js in the same repo uses var, so the project does follow this rule.
bugReports.evidence: Grep for '\bvar\s+\w+\s*=' under ui/src matches only Layout.astro and ForecastUtils.js. The diff's new files use const exclusively.

bugReports.title: ThemeToggle and the inline pre-paint script have no tests
stepsToReproduce: Search ui/src for test files that import ThemeToggle.jsx or Layout.astro
Note that only ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js exists for the theme feature
bugReports.expected: Global testing conventions §1.1 and AGENTS.md ('Create comprehensive tests for new classes'): new behaviour ships with tests. The inline script duplicates resolveIsDark logic and could drift from theme.js.
bugReports.actual: The cycle, live listener and inline script (which duplicates theme.js logic) are covered only by manual checks. The acceptance criteria only require theme.js unit tests, so this is not a blocker.
bugReports.evidence: Layout.astro comment: 'Mirrors resolveIsDark in src/lib/theme.js'. No test references the inline script.

bugReports.title: Dark-mode coverage of existing light-only classes is unverified across modals and cards
stepsToReproduce: Enable dark mode via the theme button
Open the create/edit/confirm modals and the investment summary/details components
Look for surfaces using classes outside global.css overrides, such as bg-blue-100 in CombinedForecastGraphModal.jsx:84
bugReports.expected: Body, header and text colours switch with the theme (acceptance criterion 8), with no light surface on a dark page.
bugReports.actual: global.css overrides cover bg-white, gray and slate shades, but not accent shades such as bg-blue-100 or bg-red-50. Those render light-on-dark with no in-browser check. The manual browser checks from the test plan were not run.
bugReports.evidence: Grep for bg/text/border with blue/red/green 50-200 shades found at least one uncovered usage in CombinedForecastGraphModal.jsx:84; the 91 light-utility matches across 24 files were only partly matched by global.css.

data.recommendation: In ui/src/lib/theme.js, ui/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx and ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js, change local declarations from const to var, as AGENTS.md requires, and keep the existing tests green. Then add a ThemeToggle or inline-script test, or at least a manual browser pass across the modals (CombinedForecastGraphModal.jsx:84 uses bg-blue-100), before merge.
